canonical.behaviour: Agreement 7 (D35, R41-R44) on top of offer #7: before any debater launch, /spar shows one start card that asks only what the command did not state: effort (Quick up to 6 launches, Normal up to 10, Thorough up to 14, Until agreement), the two debaters (a recommended pair from two different makers among the available models, or the owner's choice) and the record (Keep a SPAR.md or Conversation only). Until agreement asks for a launch cap each time (20, 30, 50 or the owner's number, at least 6) and ends on agreement, deadlock (two full rounds with nothing material new) or the cap, each reported as itself; two launches stay reserved for the final acceptance check and the cap is never passed without the owner's OK. In every effort, 'agreed' means both debaters accepted the exact text of the same proposal id; an amended or merged version is labelled an unreviewed coordinator synthesis until both accept it. Briefs tell debaters that justified disagreement is success and that a changed position needs its reason. Approving this offer also agrees to agreement 7.
